title: xAI releases Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 with comprehensive upgrades in speech recognition and AI agent capabilities

content_html:
xAI has launched its new speech recognition model, Grok Voice Think Fast2.0, which is now available to developers building voice-powered agents. It offers improvements in intelligence level, transcription accuracy, dialogue capabilities, and tool calling efficiency. The model is priced at $0.08 per minute of audio. xAI states that no changes are needed to existing prompts, and Think Fast2.0 can bring performance improvements in most application scenarios.

In the Artificial Analysis speech recognition benchmark test, Grok Voice Think Fast2.0 achieved a comprehensive score of 82.9%, higher than the previous version Think Fast1.0's 75.7%, as well as exceeding GPT-Realtime-2.1's 79.1% and Gemini3.1Flash's 69.5%. Its agent capability score reached 56.5%, leading Think Fast1.0's 52.1%, GPT-Realtime-2.1's 45.7%, and Gemini3.1Flash's 37.7%. The model's first audio playback time was reduced from 1.25 seconds to 0.70 seconds, further improving response speed.

In terms of speech transcription, xAI tested large amounts of voice clips in 24 languages. Official data shows that compared to Deepgram Nova3 and ElevenLabs Scribe v2, the transcription accuracy of Think Fast2.0 has improved by about 1.5 to 2 times; compared to the previous generation model, it has improved by about 1.4 times. In complex environments such as background noise and phone compression, xAI says the difference can expand to about 10 times.

On the technical side, Think Fast2.0 supports parallel speech inference, improving processing efficiency for complex tasks by reducing waiting time. Compared to the previous generation model, the median number of inference tokens used has dropped to 0.4, allowing tool calls to typically be executed before the agent completes its first sentence reply. At the same time, reinforcement learning has optimized the model's dialogue strategy, making it tend to use shorter answers, handle one issue at a time, and reduce the output of irrelevant information, thereby better supporting complex workflows.

xAI stated that this upgrade mainly focuses on enhancing the reliability of voice Agents in real business scenarios. Currently, Grok Voice is undergoing A/B testing in Starlink telephone services and has brought improvements in sales conversion rates and customer service response efficiency.

According to the plan, on August 5, 2026, the grok-voice-latest alias will automatically switch from grok-voice-think-fast-1.0 to grok-voice-think-fast-2.0. Developers who still need to use the old version should lock the 1.0 version identifier in advance. Other users do not need any additional actions.

As AI Agents gradually enter practical application scenarios such as customer service, sales, and office work, speech models with low latency, high accuracy, and multi-tool collaboration are becoming an important foundation for the next stage of intelligent interaction.

content_html_zh:
xAI 推出了新的语音识别模型 Grok Voice Think Fast2.0，现已可供构建语音驱动代理的开发人员使用。 它在智能水平、转录准确性、对话能力和工具调用效率方面提供了改进。 该型号的售价为每分钟音频 0.08 美元。 xAI表示，无需对现有提示进行任何改变，Think Fast2.0可以在大多数应用场景下带来性能提升。

在Artificial Analysis语音识别基准测试中，Grok Voice Think Fast2.0的综合得分为82.9%，高于之前版本Think Fast1.0的75.7%，也超过了GPT-Realtime-2.1的79.1%和Gemini3.1Flash的69.5%。 其代理能力得分达到56.5%，领先Think Fast1.0的52.1%、GPT-Realtime-2.1的45.7%和Gemini3.1Flash的37.7%。 该机型首次音频播放时间从1.25秒缩短至0.70秒，响应速度进一步提升。

在语音转录方面，xAI测试了24种语言的大量语音片段。 官方数据显示，相比 Deepgram Nova3 和 ElevenLabs Scribe v2，Think Fast2.0 的转录准确率提升了约 1.5 至 2 倍；与上一代机型相比，性能提升约1.4倍。 xAI 表示，在背景噪声和电话压缩等复杂环境中，差异可能会扩大到约 10 倍。

在技​​术方面，Think Fast2.0支持并行语音推理，通过减少等待时间来提高复杂任务的处理效率。 与上一代模型相比，所使用的推理令牌的中位数已降至 0.4，这使得工具调用通常可以在代理完成其第一句话回复之前执行。 同时，强化学习优化了模型的对话策略，使其倾向于使用较短的答案，一次处理一个问题，减少不相关信息的输出，从而更好地支持复杂的工作流程。

xAI表示，本次升级主要是增强语音Agent在真实业务场景下的可靠性。 目前，Grok Voice 正在 Starlink 电话服务中进行 A/B 测试，并带来了销售转化率和客户服务响应效率的提升。

根据计划，2026年8月5日，grok-voice-latest别名将自动从grok-voice-think-fast-1.0切换为grok-voice-think-fast-2.0。 仍需要使用旧版本的开发者应提前锁定1.0版本标识符。 其他用户不需要任何额外操作。

随着AI Agent逐渐进入客服、销售、办公等实际应用场景，低时延、高精度、多工具协同的语音模型正在成为下一阶段智能交互的重要基础。
